title: [Anthus-One] Repo README is a placeholder and the repo is empty
description:
**Problem**
The AnthusAI/Anthus-One repo is empty: its README is a 72-byte placeholder with the title and a one-line description, and there is no code or docs. A visitor to the repo learns nothing about what Anthus One is or its status.

**Evidence**
- https://github.com/AnthusAI/Anthus-One README: "# Anthus-One / Anthus One: unified account portal for Anthus AI Solutions" and nothing else.
- The design lives in the Prospectus repo at docs/accounts/ANTHUS_ONE_PORTAL.md.

**Fix**
Write a README that says what Anthus One is, its status (planned or built), and links to the design doc; or archive/make private the repo until work starts.

**How to verify**
`gh api repos/AnthusAI/Anthus-One/readme --jq .size` returns more than 500 bytes, or the repo is archived/private.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
